en: The Triplet of the Trainee (Sekkhattika), The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika).

Conditioned by a state that is neither-learner-nor-unwholesome, a learner wholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition], there are six; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, there are six.

Conditioned by a state that is neither-learner-nor-unwholesome, a neither-learner-nor-non-learner unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition], there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, there are three.

Dependent on a state that is neither-for-trainees-nor-for-those-beyond-training and indeterminate, there arises a state that is neither-for-trainees-nor-for-those-beyond-training and indeterminate by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five; under predominance condition there are five … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are five.
